analyst_view.overall: Leaders Barcelona (36 points, 12 wins in 13) visit 12th-placed Deportivo (15 points, one home league defeat in six) on Sunday, after playing Sabah in Baku on Wednesday and before hosting Atlético. Lamine Yamal stayed home from Baku only as a precaution for mild ankle discomfort, and Flick and several outlets expect him at Riazor, while the numbers count him as out; Fermín López is suspended (counted; one report says the club is trying to cut the second game). Balde picked up an ankle problem in Baku and Christensen is a doubt, while Rodri, Espart and Bardghji are out, and Flick is expected to rotate somewhat. Antonio Hidalgo's Deportivo get striker Eddahchouri back in training after wrist surgery, Bright Ede is still out, and Aubameyang trained normally after a minor car accident on Thursday but may be limited in minutes after knee surgery. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, but they take about 17% off Barcelona's scoring for Lamine Yamal being out, and the club and several outlets now expect him to play at Riazor; Fermín's ban, also counted, stands. I size it at +7%, to about 3.3, rather than adding back the whole amount, because Flick may manage Yamal's minutes with Atlético next and Aubameyang may not last the full game for Deportivo.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.0 corners, with Barcelona's lower recent corner count already taken off. Barcelona should have most of the ball and Deportivo may defend with five, which can bring corners, but the numbers' corner figures were not reduced for Yamal, so his return adds nothing here. I stay at 11.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards, already raised for Deportivo's recent bookings and the many cards Barcelona's opponents have taken lately. No referee has been named and nothing in the news points to an unusually heated game, so I stay at 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.4 shots, about 18.6 for Barcelona, with their high recent shooting already added. The shot figures take nothing off for Yamal, so his return adds nothing, and some rotation before Atlético pulls slightly the other way; I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, with both sides' recent accuracy already counted. Eddahchouri back for Deportivo and a possibly short game for Aubameyang change who shoots more than how often, so I stay at about 10.
